prompt:
Create a 16×16 pixel art warrior unit for a turn-based strategy game.
Top-down / slightly isometric perspective.
Bright, readable silhouette.
Simple shapes and strong contrast so it is clear at small size.
Warrior should hold a short sword or spear and have a small shield.
Use a limited color palette (3–5 colors).
Style similar to Polytopia: cute, blocky, minimalistic, no outlines, clean shading.
Make the unit look distinct from the terrain and easy to recognize on a grid.
Centered sprite with transparent background.
